dialogues.speaker: Sandrone
dialogues.text: Aren't you meant to be taking a break? No need to fuss over me... I'll just have a look around myself.

dialogues.speaker: Sandrone
dialogues.text: If you really want to do something for me... why don't you tell me about that device over there? It looks... vaguely interesting, at least.

dialogues.speaker: Sandrone
dialogues.text: "A Mysterious Device That Can Play Music"...? Hah. Who came up with that awful name?

dialogues.speaker: Sandrone
dialogues.text: Hmph... Can't help but wonder what Alain might have said if he'd seen this.

dialogues.speaker: Sandrone
dialogues.text: Magic may be no more fundamental than mathematics in underpinning the laws of this world, yet it often accomplishes with ease what machines struggle to do.

dialogues.speaker: Sandrone
dialogues.text: Explaining magical phenomena through mathematical models is certainly a challenge, I won't deny that.

dialogues.speaker: Sandrone
dialogues.text: I hear that the mages are fond of tea parties too. I bet you could fit about ten people around that table over there...

dialogues.speaker: Sandrone
dialogues.text: Hmph, sounds a bit too busy and overcomplicated for my liking.

dialogues.speaker: Sandrone
dialogues.text: ...Wh—What do you mean? Of course that's how I really feel about it! Besides, it'd be unfair on Fagio... Imagine all that cleaning!
